ads.body: We show ads served by Google AdSense to keep JaurTools free. Google may use cookies to personalize ads based on your visits to this and other sites. You can opt out of personalized advertising in your Google Ads Settings. We never click our own ads and we never ask anyone to click them.
ads.title: Advertising (Google AdSense)

analytics.body: If you consent to analytics, we use privacy-friendly measurement to understand which tools are popular. This data is aggregated and anonymous — it is never tied to your identity.
analytics.title: Analytics

children.body: JaurTools is a general-audience site and does not knowingly collect data from children. Since our tools process everything locally, there is nothing for a child to submit to us in the first place.
children.title: Children

collection.body: We do not ask you to sign up, and we do not store the content you enter into tools. The only things stored on your device are small local preferences you explicitly choose: your theme (light/dark), your language, and your cookie consent choice. These never leave your browser.
collection.title: What we collect

contact.body: Questions about this policy? Email us at jaurazmi42@gmail.com.
contact.title: Contact

cookies.body: We use a small number of cookies and local-storage entries, all consent-based: Necessary (theme, language, consent choice — always on); Preferences (your site choices); Analytics (anonymous usage statistics — only if you accept). You can change your choice anytime from “Cookie Settings” in the footer.
cookies.title: Cookies

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: JaurTools privacy policy: our tools run in your browser, what you type never leaves your device, and cookies are consent-based.

overview.body: JaurTools is designed to collect as little data as possible. Our tools run entirely in your browser — anything you type into a tool stays on your device and is never sent to our servers, because there are no servers processing your input.
overview.title: Overview

thirdParty.body: Some pages may embed third-party resources such as fonts. Those providers may collect standard technical data (like your IP address) according to their own policies.
thirdParty.title: Third-party content
